subject: Request: short trial top-up & 2-week extension due to weekend integration stall
messages:
From: Maria Torres <maria.torres@blueloom.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex.chen@blueloom.ai>, dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-16T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC: integration stalled over weekend — can we extend trial window?

Hi Soojin,

Quick note from our side: we hit an unexpected break in the connector over the weekend (attached log) — the engineering team spent Monday repro'ing it and we only just got a stable patch in our staging environment. Because of the delay our POC timeline slipped by ~8 business days.

Given that, can Redwood approve a 2-week extension on our sandbox credits and add a small top-up (enough for 50k tokens) so we can finish the last verification runs and a short demo next week? We're on a tight internal board review cycle; without the runs we can't complete evaluation.

Happy to jump on a quick call if useful. Thanks — really appreciate any help to keep the momentum.

Best,
Maria Torres
Senior Product Manager, BlueLoom Analytics

Attachments: integration-error-log.txt (plain text, 23 KB)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Maria Torres <maria.torres@blueloom.ai>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@blueloom.ai>
Cc: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-16T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC: integration stalled over weekend — can we extend trial window?

Hi Maria — thanks for the heads up and for sending the log. Sorry to hear about the weekend stall.

I pulled in Dylan (who's been supporting BlueLoom's adapter) so we have clear visibility on the tech side. From a commercial standpoint, we do have a standard process for short trial extensions and one-off sandbox top-ups for situations like this. To move quickly, can you confirm:

- Exact additional tokens you need (you mentioned ~50k; confirm whether that's generation tokens or embedding units)
- New target date for the final demo
- Any data residency or private deployment needs for the demo environment

If you can reply with that by EOD we can start approval and get a DocuSign/extension link over.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Enterprise AE (Trial Accounts) | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0194
From: dylan_brooks@redwood.com <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Torres <maria.torres@blueloom.ai>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@blueloom.ai>
Date: 2027-04-16T18:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC: integration stalled over weekend — can we extend trial window?

Hey all — quick tech note from my side: the attached log shows a KV cache mismatch when the connector retries with batched requests; the fix we applied reduces retry volume and cuts token consumption by roughly 20% for their workload. That means Maria's ask for 50k generation tokens should be enough to complete the verification and run the demo prompts once.

I'd recommend: 2-week extension + 60k generation token top-up (to have a small buffer). If commercial is OK with the buffer, I can re-run the baseline tests tomorrow and confirm final numbers.

Dylan Brooks
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-17T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Requesting approval: BlueLoom 2-week extension + 60k token top-up (DL-2027-0418-BL)

Marissa — looping you in for quick approval. BlueLoom hit an integration stall over the weekend; Dylan produced a fix and estimates they need ~60k generation tokens and a two-week extension to finish validation and demo.

Why this is high-priority: the account is on an active board review and the demo next week drives conversion. They're a mid-market analytics platform with clear expansion potential.

Proposed commercial terms: 2-week extension, 60k generation tokens complimentary, and we add a one-time 5% promotional credit for the first paid month if they convert within 30 days.

Attachments: SOW_Blueloom_v1.pdf

Can you approve or let me know changes? If approved I will send the DocuSign extension and confirm scheduling with Maria.

Thanks,
Soojin
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-17T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Requesting approval: BlueLoom 2-week extension + 60k token top-up (DL-2027-0418-BL)

Approved.

Two small asks: 1) record the top-up as a non-recurring promotional credit in HubSpot (deal DL-2027-0418-BL), and 2) add the 5% convert credit to the invoice comments so Billing can apply it automatically.

Once recorded, proceed to send the extension link and confirm the demo time. Happy to escalate if any follow-ons come up.

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Maria Torres <maria.torres@blueloom.ai>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@blueloom.ai>
Cc: dylan_brooks@redwood.com, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T11:52:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed: 2-week sandbox extension + 60k token top-up (DL-2027-0418-BL)

Hi Maria / Alex — good news: Marissa approved the extension and top-up. Summary: 2-week trial extension starting 2027-04-18, one-time 60,000 generation token credit added to the sandbox, and a 5% promotional convert credit applied to the first paid invoice if you convert within 30 days.

I've recorded the credit in HubSpot and Billing has been notified to add the invoice comment. Please sign the short extension form here to finalize: docsign_extension_link.url

Dylan will run a quick baseline tomorrow morning (9 AM PT) and then we can lock in your demo slot for next Wednesday at 11:00 AM PT — does that work for you?

Thanks again for the rapid troubleshooting on your side. We're excited to see BlueLoom's integration complete.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
Attachments: docsign_extension_link.url (DocuSign link), SOW_Blueloom_v1.pdf
